name: Voltail
notes: Voltail: a yellow ferret with a round brown patch around each eye and a lightning-bolt tail. Type ELECTRIC. Moves: Thunder Shock (A), Spark (B) and Thunderbolt (R). Walks at 70 % speed: its move 1 (Thunder Shock) reaches 5 tiles, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. Its moves hit 10 % softer than their power says (power 90 %), whether it is the player or a wild one, in every mode. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: VOLTAIL
